description:
We are a passionate team of Computer Science, Business, Mechatronics Engineering, and Applied Arts (Product Design) students, eager to learn and build creative solutions for real-world space and Earth challenges.

By combining our diverse backgrounds in programming, engineering, business strategy, and product design, we aim to work on a well-rounded project that bridges technical ideas with practical implementation.
summary:
6S Nova is a climate intelligence platform that turns 24 years of real NASA data into statistically verified trends and actionable warnings for Greater Cairo and Egypt.

We built a tool that lets users select Earth science variables from NASA POWER MERA-2 (2000–2023), including temperature, wind, rainfall, humidity, and solar radiation, and visualize how they change over time. To test whether a change is real, the platform applies the Mann-Kendall significance test (p < 0.05), the Theil-Sen slope for the rate of change per decade, and the Pettitt test to detect the year a climate shift occurred. A Prophet model then forecasts 2024–2034 with 95% confidence intervals.

The results feed a Telegram bot (@sixsnova_bot) that sends bilingual alerts for heat waves, dust storms, flash floods, and green-space deficits, paired with practical solutions such as rooftop gardens and Miyawaki micro-forests.

It matters because Cairo’s urban heat islands and lack of green space put millions of people at risk, and 6S Nova makes NASA data understandable and useful for citizens and decision-makers.
details:
6S Nova is a web platform that detects, tests, and forecasts climate trends for Greater Cairo and Egypt using real NASA data only. Users select a variable (2 m temperature, wind speed, precipitation, relative humidity, or solar radiation) from NASA POWER MERRA-2 monthly data (2000–2023) and see how it changed over time. The platform then tests whether the change is real: the Mann-Kendall test (p < 0.05) confirms a significant trend, the Theil-Sen slope gives a robust rate of change per decade, and the Pettitt test identifies the year of a climate shift. A Prophet model forecasts 2024–2034 with 95% confidence intervals. An AI assistant (AURA, powered by Gemini) explains the results and suggests actions in Arabic and English.

Additional modules
A Green Space Sentinel covers 10 Cairo districts with NDVI and per-capita green area, compared against WHO standards. A Heritage Sentinel covers 14 Egyptian heritage sites with 7-day forecasts and warnings about heat and salt damage to stone. A 3D globe (Three.js) shows heat, rainfall, and wind layers.

Benefits and intended impact
Cairo faces urban heat islands and a severe shortage of green space. 6S Nova turns complex satellite data into clear, statistically verified information, and a Telegram bot (@sixsnova_bot) sends five types of bilingual alerts (heat, wind and dust, urban flooding, humid heat stress, green-space deficit) directly to citizens and officials. Each alert comes with practical solutions such as rooftop gardens, street trees, and Miyawaki micro-forests. The goal is to support earlier action and better planning.

Tools and technologies
Python 3, FastAPI, Uvicorn, Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Prophet, Gemini API, Telegram Bot API, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, Three.js/WebGL, Leaflet, and Chart.js.

Creativity
The project combines rigorous trend statistics, forecasting, generative AI, a live alert system, and an interactive 3D globe in one tool, so users get both the science and the next step to take.

Factors our team considered
We used only real, documented data (no synthetic values), followed NASA GES DISC time-series methodology, and chose statistical tests that are robust to outliers. We prioritized accessibility through Telegram and bilingual support, and we kept the interface simple for non-experts.
